title: fix(clawrouter): edit uploaded images with the selected OpenAI model
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: uploaded reference images are rejected when users select a supported OpenAI image model through ClawRouter.

## User Impact

Users can edit authorized PNG, JPEG, or WebP references with the exact selected ClawRouter OpenAI image model and credential; text-only generation stays unchanged.

The companion JSON edit route in [openclaw/clawrouter#1002](https://github.com/openclaw/clawrouter/pull/1002) is also merged; deployment has not been verified. It does not deploy or activate that service, change credentials or grants, or relax budgets. Existing hard-budget policies still reject edits because reference-image input tokens do not yet have a safe reservation upper bound, unless an explicit fixed policy tariff already applies. Existing soft/unmetered policies can proceed and settle complete, consistent measured usage; this change does not alter those policies. References are limited to 16, 4 MiB decoded each, and 8 MiB for the whole JSON request. Masks, remote reference URLs/file IDs on the wire, and streaming remain unsupported.

## Why This Change Was Made

Hannes requested OpenAI image editing through ClawRouter and explicitly authorized both the backend and this plugin change. The previous generation-only scope intentionally rejected edits; this change adds the separately granted edit route rather than assuming that generation access also allows editing.

The existing plugin now admits exact qualified models, requires a same-key edit capability and offer, and sends inline references to the edit endpoint. Existing request deadlines, cancellation, SSRF/download guards, secret-safe failures, and non-retrying paid requests remain shared with generation. No core production code, new configuration, SDK surface, or provider substitution is added.

Requested by @hannesrudolph; co-author credit is included in the commit.

## Work sessions

Linked for team reference; these sessions aren’t public.

- [Original discussion with @hannesrudolph](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/2ded57ed-2a92-4507-8666-0bdf27d05d06)
- [Implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/7452dc32-8857-46a4-952f-e64ccb24f667)

## Evidence

- Base: `76024435027d4ac4e51a58468bb1b5c4842d9fb0`. Simplified candidate: `fdfd451e597daf450d1b091d7656fce7080c0bf7`; published head: `dd737e224069095e2fd0d396e9bebe0f432ccf27`. Both have tree `32455c67b4672b8f19024a6c3804df0ef77e0c66`.
- Whole-patch surgical audit reduced the complete six-file PR from **+435/−74 to +367/−71**, not just its production code. Removed the duplicate no-reference tool case and generation fixture, manual listener setup, duplicate operation records, repeated catalog-auth/empty-catalog setup, and repeated documentation. The retained no-reference provider test owns generation preservation; all three catalog modes and all distinct grant/media/budget/cancellation/no-retry scenarios remain. Production files are byte-identical to the earlier reviewed and cross-tested head: +68/−18. Current tests: +282/−45; docs: +17/−8.
- The simplified uploaded-PNG regression still fails on the original base with “does not support reference-image edit inputs” and passes on the candidate. It invokes `createImageGenerateTool.execute` with real inbound storage, native provider loading, a locked router profile alongside a different configured direct-OpenAI credential, real HTTP, and persisted output readback. **1/1 passes**, 2.744 seconds test time (45.16 seconds including worker compilation).
- Image-provider and capability-offer suites: **47/47 pass**, including the three listing-mode cases now sharing one test setup. Combined duration 15.62 seconds including compilation. Focused source/test types, compiled plugin-boundary types, scoped lint, formatting, and whitespace checks pass. Exact-head [CI run 43309498412](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43309498412) succeeded: 53 jobs, 23 executed, 4,529 observed job-seconds—not billing or incremental test cost. Required CI and applicable security-review checks passed.
- Cross-repository proof on November 12, 2026 used the unchanged plugin production code and backend candidate `835991ce5771d9034ca16b4522ce01b929d19f00` (tree `686614388d6e6f619185a41f82241f56eb336e98`) through real isolated Workerd HTTP/Durable Object/SQL with a synthetic upstream. Exactly one uploaded-PNG tool call reached the exact selected sunburst snapshot's edit endpoint and persisted a 103-byte 2×2 PNG. The 68-byte input SHA-256 was `b6468fc1098ff44210d981565f98f2c62e409e617cff260fa8e59354c1fd549c`; output SHA-256 was `1069874ff9f2bcbe23c8a8c762e20670861ad6a291e205bdd2f3afeb4022f305`. Usage recorded 12 text-input, 100 image-input, and 100 image-output tokens, 3,860 synthetic cost micros, with one settled tenant charge and one settled provider charge.
- Fresh independent six-file source review, the completed local ClawSweeper review, and hosted ClawSweeper review of prior head `65bc6c2669d9814601ffeca74becf8ee850b4af7` found no actionable code defect. The substantive three-file simplification delta received a complete independent AutoReview at P0–P2: scoped-clean, no actionable findings. Existing production and cross-repository proof is carried forward by exact blob identity, not claimed as a new run.
- The earlier local review requested shipped CLI/Gateway/channel proof. A supported task-isolated CLI attempt stopped before startup at the runtime-artifact publication safety guard; zero requests were dispatched, and neither the guard nor the installed Gateway was changed. This limitation remains disclosed. The local P3 suggestion to remove authenticated Work sessions links was declined under the explicit workspace requirement; no sharing permissions changed. No review was rerun merely to improve a grade.

Focused commands:

```sh
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/image-generate-tool.clawrouter.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clawrouter/image-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/clawrouter/capability-offers.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p extensions/clawrouter/tsconfig.json --noEmit
```

Proof limits: the cross-repository run used synthetic credentials, policy, responses, and usage. It proves actual local plugin/backend routing, persistence, and accounting integration, not paid OpenAI fulfillment, current hosted deployment, real billing, or a full agent/Gateway/channel invocation. No paid provider calls, deployment, live Gateway changes, or policy changes were performed. Both PRs are merged; hosted availability still requires deployment through its own authorized workflow and has not been verified here.
